candidates.hook: Alexander lunges forward in handcuffs screaming, "Juliana, stop!" as she drops to her knees before the blackthorn briars.
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana lies bleeding in the thorns praying, "Please, ring... you have to be here," just as her blood-smeared finger touches a metallic object in the dirt.
candidates.why: Extremely high physical stakes and visceral sacrifice with cruel villains taunting, ending right before the ring reveal.

candidates.hook: A blackthorn needle stabs deep into Juliana's bleeding hand with a crunch as Alexander begs, "Please... enough!"
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana's blood-smeared finger brushes against a solid metallic object half-buried under the icy thorns.
candidates.why: Starts on a shocking moment of visceral pain and cuts right at the physical touch of the missing signet ring.

candidates.hook: Alexander fights his manacles shouting, "I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me!"
candidates.cliffhanger: Juliana screams in agony as thorns lacerate her cheek while Alexander violently breaks free from the constable roaring, "Stop!"
candidates.why: Highlights the dramatic romance and vow of loyalty before escalating into brutal physical chaos.

moments.desc: Juliana drops to her knees and crawls into briars as Alexander roars in panic, "Juliana, stop!"
Clarissa and Gerald taunt Juliana from the terrace while her hands bleed on frozen stone.
A giant blackthorn needle pierces Juliana's hand with a crunch while Alexander cries out in agony.
Juliana's bloody finger touches the half-buried emerald signet ring beneath the thorny branches.
